findingDetails.title: Cursor's command mirror does not expose the documented /speckit:handoff name
A failed or skipped continuity save can still produce a prepared hop

traceabilityChecks.spec_code: Cursor and Devin are documented command-only, but the Cursor file-derived invocation name does not match the namespaced name in the runtime matrix.
traceabilityChecks.checklist_evidence: Deferred to iteration 10's final adversarial pass.
traceabilityChecks.skill_agent: Plain-command structure and router-contract applicability checked; invocation naming and the blocking-save gate have findings.
traceabilityChecks.feature_catalog_code: The command-only runtime description aligns with manual handoff; exact per-runtime triggers need clarification.

reviewDepthApplicability.reason: The command crosses runtime-specific invocation adapters and a stateful multi-step handoff protocol.

targetSelection.selectionReason: Follow the two command-only entry surfaces into the canonical handoff workflow and the command-authoring contract, then inspect prepare to determine whether prerequisite completion is enforced.
omittedHighRiskTargets: Open adapter findings are reserved for the iteration 10 adversarial pass.

searchLedger.hypothesis: The advertised colon namespace may not resolve to the flat Cursor command mirror.
searchLedger.invariant: A command-only runtime's documented trigger must resolve to its available command file.
searchLedger.rationale: The README advertises /speckit:handoff for Cursor, while the only project command mirror is speckit-handoff.md; official command docs describe file-based project commands.

searchActions.result: Cursor mirror is a flat symlink named speckit-handoff.md; the table labels its trigger /speckit:handoff. Official Cursor command docs describe .cursor/commands/[command].md and the supported name form.

searchLedger.hypothesis: A skipped or failed continuity save may not prevent handoff preparation.
searchLedger.invariant: A bound packet must have fresh continuity before the receiver claims and resumes it.
searchLedger.rationale: The prepare CLI validates note/session state and writes a record but does not receive or verify save completion.

searchActions.result: The command requires save-before-prepare, while prepare validates the note and session and writes the pending record without a continuity-save status check.

searchLedger.hypothesis: The handoff command may miss required structure, arguments, examples, or status output.
searchLedger.invariant: A plain no-argument workflow uses the common command sections and does not require router assets.
searchLedger.rationale: The command has canonical numbered sections, no required argument, two examples, structured statuses, and the machine contract explicitly excludes it from router families.
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: The plain-command structure and router-contract scope match the reviewed authoring guidance.

searchActions.result: Frontmatter, section numbering, examples, statuses, and plain-command exclusion are present.

searchLedger.hypothesis: Devin may have neither a mirrored slash command nor a documented way to invoke handoff.
searchLedger.invariant: When Devin has no command surface, the manual path must identify the canonical command file for direct execution.
searchLedger.rationale: The sync manifest confirms no command surface and the session-relaunch README explicitly instructs Devin to read and follow the canonical file.
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: The direct-file fallback is documented, though the shared matrix's slash-command shorthand is misleading.

searchActions.result: Devin has no mirrored command tree; README specifies direct reading of the canonical handoff command.

searchLedger.hypothesis: The command-path or failed-save defect may already be recorded in prior review outputs.
searchLedger.invariant: A prior finding should be reused only if the current code still exhibits that exact defect.
searchLedger.rationale: The targeted search found older handoff items but no matching Cursor command-name or skipped-save finding; the existing exit-3 and note-supersession findings are addressed in the current command.
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: No prior report records either current finding, and the adjacent old handoff issues were rechecked as fixed.

searchActions.result: No matching command-name or skipped-save defect. Prior exit-3 and open-note findings are addressed at current handoff.md:105-107,135.
